comparison.objective: Reconnect a sink pop-up stopper to its pivot rod; candidate commissions an adjustable damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Blindly align and capture a stopper eye with a lateral pivot rod and reassemble drain linkage versus hex engagement, collar adjustment, relocking, and guarded impact testing.
comparison.success_condition: The drain linkage must reconnect and operate the stopper; candidate instead requires quantified safe and repeatable carriage stopping. The record provides no comparable damper-response thresholds.
comparison.reason: Hidden linkage capture and functional drain operation are meaningfully different from tuning and validating energy absorption.
